claim.natural: The least n such that every red-blue edge-colouring of K_n contains two vertex-disjoint monochromatic copies of K_4 is 20; the copies need not have the same colour.

limitations: The upper bound reuses the parent z(20) candidate's two fixed-core CNFs and DRUP/LRAT refutations rather than independently reproducing them.
Certificate checking establishes unsatisfiability only for the exact pinned CNFs.
The catalogue, graph-to-CNF translation, and bridge from exact-CNF unsatisfiability to the graph-theoretic upper bound have not been independently audited or formalized end to end.
The dependency and its positive assessments are repository-reported and externally unauthenticated.
dependencies.statement: For each of the two order-16 (4,4)-Ramsey cores used in the pinned z(20) release, the exact fixed-core CNF over the 64 cross edges is unsatisfiable.

downstream.statement: May be cited or investigated only as an unrefereed candidate that VR_2(K_4)=20, with the two copies allowed to have different colours. The lower construction is hand-checkable and has a standard-library verifier, while the upper bound reuses the parent candidate's exact fixed-core CNF certificates. Certificate checking covers only those exact CNFs; the catalogue and graph-to-CNF semantic bridge remain separate, unauthenticated, and not formalized end to end. No independent reproduction, complete human review, complete objection search, or extremal-colouring uniqueness or enumeration is established.

notes: The supplied release artifacts distinguish a direct 19-vertex lower construction from a certificate-backed inherited upper bound. Repository-reported one-machine replay is not independent reproduction. The snapshot contains no objection records, but its search coverage is incomplete. UNKNOWN is a permission decision under the supplied policy, not a global truth verdict.
